curated.tagline: AI-agent activity radar — Perplexity numbat findings on the bar
curated.description: Bar widget + panel over Perplexity's open-source numbat agentic monitor. Severity-gated toasts on new findings only (with per-rule cooldowns, burst coalescing, DND suppression), unseen-count badge, agent filters, and a rotation hint for the unbounded records file.
highlights: Severity-gated toasts — quiet by default, critical stays until clicked
Per-rule cooldown + burst coalescing keeps alerts honest
Read-only: tails records.ndjson, never writes to the monitor
Listed on the official Omarchy plugin marketplace
curated.architecture: numbat records tail → findings feed (1MiB bounded tail) → severity gate → toasts + panel
